name: Concentrix Corporation
summary:
Concentrix (CNXC) reported earnings of $2.92 per share on revenue of $2.45 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $2.71 per share on revenue of $2.48 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $2.67 per share. The company beat expectations by 9.36% while revenue fell 1.19% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it expects fourth quarter non-GAAP earnings of $2.86 to $2.98 per share on revenue of $2.41 billion to $2.46 billion. The current consensus earnings estimate is $3.06 per share on revenue of $2.48 billion for the quarter ending November 30, 2026.

Concentrix is the Fortune 500® technology and services company, helping the world's best brands create intelligent operations that perform in the real world.
subject: Concentrix Beat Expectations

name: Carnival Corporation
summary:
Carnival (CCL) reported earnings of $1.43 per share on revenue of $8.44 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.36 per share on revenue of $8.36 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.37 per share. The company beat expectations by 4.38% while revenue grew 3.46% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects fourth quarter non-GAAP earnings of approximately $0.20 per share. The current consensus earnings estimate is $0.24 per share for the quarter ending November 30, 2026.

"We delivered another quarter of top and bottom-line records, with accelerating demand and even stronger cost discipline driving results ahead of our expectations. This performance reinforces the underlying trajectory of our business and the consistency of our commercial execution, as evidenced by our sustained track record of high-quality same-ship yield growth," said Carnival Corporation's Chief Executive Officer Josh Weinstein.

Carnival Corporation & plc is the largest global cruise company, and among the largest leisure travel companies
subject: Carnival Beat Expectations

name: ZenaTech, Inc.
summary:

ZenaTech Inc. is a technology company specializing in AI drone solutions and enterprise SaaS solutions for mission-critical business applications. It operates principally in North America, Europe and UAE. The company serves government and industrial sectors. ZenaTech Inc. is based in TORONTO, Ontario.
subject: ZenaTech Beat Consensus Estimates

name: CarMax, Inc.
summary:
CarMax (KMX) reported earnings of $1.16 per share on revenue of $7.88 billion for the fiscal second quarter ended August 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.68 per share on revenue of $7.09 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.81 per share. The company beat expectations by 43.21% while revenue grew 19.46% on a year-over-year basis.

“Our strong second quarter results reflect solid execution and early progress against Shift into GEAR, our four-pillar strategy to strengthen CarMax’s core business and return the company to sustained growth,” said Keith Barr, President and Chief Executive Officer. “We delivered 81% EPS growth as we strengthened our price competitiveness, increased Extended Protection Plan margins, expanded CAF’s share of Tier 2 originations, continued to enhance our digital experience, and drove material SG&A leverage. I am confident in our ability to build on this early momentum. We have a clear strategy, a solid foundation, and an exceptional team accelerating our progress to create long-term value for our shareholders.”

CarMax, the nation’s largest retailer of used autos, revolutionized the automotive retail industry by driving integrity, honesty and transparency in every interaction.
subject: CarMax Beat Expectations
